title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Genesis 8: the waters go down, the raven and the dove, and Noah's altar after the flood.

questions.text: What did God make to pass over the earth so that the waters subsided?
questions.explanation: God remembered Noah and the animals, and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.

questions.text: Where did the ship come to rest?
questions.explanation: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat's mountains.

questions.text: What became visible on the first day of the tenth month?
questions.explanation: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. On the first day of that month the tops of the mountains were visible.

questions.text: Which bird did Noah send out first?
questions.explanation: At the end of forty days Noah opened the window of the ship and sent out a raven, which went back and forth until the waters were dried up.

questions.text: Why did the dove return to the ship the first time?
questions.explanation: The dove found no place to rest her foot, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth.

answers.text: She found no place to rest her foot
She was afraid of the raven

questions.text: What was in the dove's mouth when she came back in the evening?
questions.explanation: The dove came back at evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf in her mouth, so Noah knew the waters were abated.

answers.text: A leaf from a fig tree

questions.text: What happened the last time Noah sent out the dove?
questions.explanation: Noah waited yet another seven days and sent out the dove, and she didn't return to him any more.

answers.text: She came back with a twig
She came back with the raven
She didn't return to him any more
She stayed on the roof of the ship

questions.text: What did Noah build after he went out of the ship?
questions.explanation: Noah built an altar to Yahweh and offered burnt offerings of every clean animal and clean bird on it.

questions.text: What did Yahweh say in his heart after smelling the pleasant aroma?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said in his heart that he would not again curse the ground any more for man's sake.

answers.text: He would not again curse the ground
He would take away the animals
He would make the earth new

questions.text: Which pair is named among the things that will not cease while the earth remains?
questions.explanation: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.
